name: Jumbo Pumbo
summary:
Congratulations on graduating from Pumbo University, class of 30XX! Now it’s time to put your degree to real world use and prove that you’re the best Pumbo Grower Ph.D. by growing the biggest pumbo you possibly can! But beware - birds and bugs like pumbos just as much as you do! If you find the provided supplies inadequate, the university shop has some fun upgrades you can buy between seasons.

Now, make us proud and go grow the biggest pumbo in the world! Grow your pumbo the size of a skyscraper in this fast paced platformer incremental game!

Part of the 2024 Game Maker's Tool Kit Game Jam.
